# Survival analysis: Kaplan-Meier, log-rank and Cox regression

> Free Kaplan-Meier survival curve calculator with log-rank test and Cox proportional hazards regression. Paste a CSV of times and events, compare groups, and get median survival with confidence intervals, hazard ratios, a proportional-hazards check and concordance. Checked against lifelines and statsmodels. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are statistical estimates from the data you supply, not medical, legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://marisstella.app/survival-analysis/)

## Use it from code

- `node cli.mjs data.csv --time weeks --event relapsed --group treatment --covariates logWBC [--json]`
- `node platform/agents/tools.mjs call survival-analysis analyze --input '{"csv":"time,event,group\n...","group":"group"}'`

## What it answers

- How long until the event, per group: median with confidence interval, restricted mean survival time.
- Do the groups' curves differ: log-rank, Gehan-Breslow or Tarone-Ware test.
- Adjusting for a variable without estimating it (or one that fails the proportional-hazards check): stratified Cox model and stratified log-rank test (`--strata sex`).
- By how much, adjusting for covariates: Cox hazard ratios (Efron or Breslow ties), likelihood-ratio, Wald and score tests, Schoenfeld proportional-hazards check, Harrell's C.
